text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky does an incredible job in the
Arima
Kinen, but she comes back with a
stern look on
her face.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I did. It was fun and all, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It was a bit... more than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I knew she was strong to begin
with and
that she'd gotten better since
healing from her
injury.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But it's like she evolved into her second
form!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course, of course. It's 'cause I used
every trick I
had up my sleeves for this.
choice_data_list: でも貴方もすごかった

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't arrogant, and I didn't
underestimate the
competition. I took it
as seriously as anyone else,
but still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She suddenly goes silent. Looking
closely, I can
tell that her shoulders are
trembling.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's what I mean. We're gonna have to
use our
heads, otherwise I won't make it
through my
senior year.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So, yeah... Let's have a super fun
strategy
meeting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Sky shakes off her worries and
readies herself
to push forward, another
figure in the vicinity
watches.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So... this is where it ends.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm finally prepared.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You have to walk your path. And I...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Will walk mine.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I wanted to talk to you
about my next
race... if ya don't mind,
hehe...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: How about we do the spring Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho is a historic race
of high
status. It's also the longest of the
G1 races at
3,200 meters.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I think I could give quite the
performance in a
long distance race.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And if I win, I can change my name to
Seiun
Stayer. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Spe will be there too. I'm sure
of it...
maybe. I just kinda feel it in my
gut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she wants to test her true ability
and face
off against her greatest rival
once more.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nice, full steam ahead.
choice_data_list: わかった、『天皇賞（春）』を走ろう

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Except... I'm out of steam for
today—like, tired as
a dog and dead on
my feet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't we have our meeting
over lunch?
Treat me to something extra
special! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That worked? It's never a bad idea to
ask! I'm
gonna eat till I drop!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
S, S, S! ♪ The S in Sky stands for... Sushi!

Sukiyaki! Seafood! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a quick refueling, we set about
ramping up
Seiun Sky's training in
preparation for the spring
Tenno Sho!
